meta.title: Persona Modes
meta.description: Switch between Catgirl, Tsundere, Sharp-tongued, Mom, Workhorse, Whale Girl, Reluctant Maid, Young Lady, Daughter, Ultraman Tiga, Yandere, Airhead, Simp Girl, Gamer Girl, Imperial Consort and Doubao tones from Settings. Choose low/medium/high intensity, edit the address, self-name and prompt, or add custom personas. Only the voice changes; facts and code stay accurate, and Off injects nothing. Includes opt-out anonymous turn counting and an in-memory debug log (debug switch on this page).
